title: Business and first class bookings
statementMd:
Count bookings in the business or first seat classes.

Expected columns: `premium_bookings`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS premium_bookings FROM bookings WHERE seat_class IN ('business', 'first');
```
